description: Spec 010 (phase 3, SRD Annex B, decision 25): the one carried network for G4, the iteration-4 instantaneous LSTM configuration (2 x 128 stacked LSTM, velocity outputs, derived features, loss_weight_speed 4, same seed) trained from scratch on generator 0.4.0 data (one target course change in 80% of scenarios, configs/phase3-ranges.json). Dataset seed 208 trains and validates; G4 is judged on a fresh test split, seed 209 at count 400,000 (its 40,000-scenario test split, generated alone), sized so the held-course control can resolve speed against 1 kt (spec 010 FR-011). The evaluation job only commits the model; the validation diagnostic (FR-007) and then G4 on the test split are scored with tma-track and tma-g4 against the frozen reference tracker named in experiments/20261028-p3-decision/decision.json.
